anchor.quote: The family sits around the table. Everyone is eating and talking about school and work.

suggestions.reason: Slow establishing small talk; open straight on the table so Rick's jab lands within two seconds. Keep line 3, since it sets up the potatoes callback.

anchor.quote: UNCLE RICK: So Aiden, still doing your little internet trading?

suggestions.text: Rick points his fork across the table at Aiden; quick push-in on Rick's smug grin.
suggestions.reason: Makes the accusation the visual hook, not just a line of dialogue.

suggestions.text: Aiden's face burns red; he grips his fork, the only one not laughing.
suggestions.reason: The humiliation is the story's engine and needs a face we can read with the sound off.

suggestions.text: Tight close-up on Aiden, eyes locked on Rick, the laughter dying around him.
suggestions.reason: This is the promise the ending pays off, so give it weight.

anchor.quote: He is angry and wants to prove Rick wrong.

suggestions.reason: Explains a feeling the camera can't show; let his actions do it.

suggestions.text: He shoves his chair back and storms off, napkin thrown on his plate.
suggestions.reason: Shows the anger instead of telling it.

anchor.quote: Aiden opens fomo on his phone.

suggestions.text: SCENE 2 — INT. AIDEN'S BASEMENT ROOM — NIGHT
suggestions.reason: Place and time change here; the script jumps from scene 1 to 3.

anchor.quote: Aiden opens fomo on his phone.

suggestions.text: ★ fomo screen: Home — on Aiden's phone as the app opens, fills the frame
suggestions.reason: Opening fomo is a brand moment that needs the real home screen.

suggestions.text: ★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on his phone, red line dropping
suggestions.reason: A loss is a fomo moment, so the real chart-down screen must show before he slams the desk.

anchor.quote: He keeps trading at his desk every night for months.

suggestions.text: ★ fomo screen: Desktop trading — on his monitor, its glow on his face as seasons change in the window behind him
suggestions.reason: The months of grinding are desk trading, so the real desktop screen shows, and the window sells the passing time with the sound off.

anchor.quote: ★ fomo screen: Wallet — showing his balance

suggestions.text: ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Aiden's phone, the line climbing, fills the frame
suggestions.reason: "Wallet" isn't a real fomo screen; the turn is a win, so it gets the chart-up screen.

anchor.quote: ★ fomo screen: Wallet — showing his balance

suggestions.text: Aiden leans back in his chair, a slow, quiet grin spreading.
suggestions.reason: The turn needs a held beat on his face before we jump a year.

anchor.quote: Aiden slides his phone across the table.

suggestions.text: ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on the phone as it stops in front of Rick, top-down insert
suggestions.reason: The proof Rick sees is fomo, so the real chart-up screen must be on that phone.

suggestions.text: Rick's fork freezes mid-air, his jaw drops; Mom hides a proud smile behind her glass.
suggestions.reason: Rick's face is the payoff of the whole video, so hold on it before the last line.
